nodes.label: Success GIF Animation
nodes.description: An animated GIF showing a person (appearing to be a public figure in a suit with a red tie) pointing upward with one finger, set in an indoor environment with warm lighting. A subtitle text reads 'Selamat berjuang! Sukses...' (Indonesian for 'Good luck! Success...'). Used as a celebratory/success feedback animation in the application UI.
